evals.prompt: An AI generated a 24-file password reset feature and says all tests pass. Decide whether I can merge it.
evals.expected_output: A risk-laned review that checks scope, auth boundaries, actual tests, and unsupported claims before a merge decision.
expectations: Identifies the exact diff and expected behavior before reviewing
Assigns a risk lane based on protected identity behavior
Builds an evidence ledger rather than trusting the generator summary
Returns MERGE, REVISE, or STOP with concrete evidence

evals.prompt: Please verify this generated copy-only change. It updates three button labels and no logic.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate L0 verification without an unnecessary repository-wide audit.

evals.prompt: The patch includes passing tests written by the same AI, but every dependency is mocked and one old integration test was deleted.
evals.expected_output: An evidence critique that spots circular proof and seeks independent behavior checks.
expectations: Does not treat mocked tests as sufficient contract evidence
Challenges at least one failure or compatibility path

evals.prompt: Review this AI patch, but I cannot tell you what it was supposed to implement.
evals.expected_output: A STOP decision because correctness cannot be evaluated without intent.
expectations: Explains why repository behavior alone cannot establish product intent
Requests the minimum missing acceptance criteria
